note: Which proof sections a changed path can affect (brief 078; tools/game/proofdelta.ts). The first row whose glob matches a path decides it. run: a list of sections, or "full" (the whole proof), or "none" (the player cannot read it; such a path is not even hashed). A path no row matches runs the whole proof and every step: that is the fail-safe, never silent (the plan, the step and shot gates name each such path, and proofwhat.test.ts fails while the tree holds one: `bun tools/game/proofwhat.ts unplaced` lists them, `diff <from> <to>` shows what a range would run), so add a row with its reason. proofdelta.test.ts holds the HUD, host and proof rows to the sources: a section that reads a HudToolkit or host member, or calls another proof's helper, must be on that file's row (setup below is the exception, with its reason; `bun tools/game/proofdelta.ts host-reads` prints the table). steps: the batch's gated steps the path can affect; absent, a full row forces them all and a list row none. shots: the rows of shots.json the path can show in (none: the shots and budget steps skip it). seconds: each section's share of the 0.2.146 proof, for the estimate only (frame-time spots are out of the proof, `--spots`; r118 was thinned from 185 s).

setup.why: host calls every proof makes to reach its moment (start a run, pause, step the clock, select, give an order, find a view, close a ring, turn the view). They run in whichever section runs, so a break in them shows there; hostGaps does not count them, or every section would sit on the host's core row.

the whole file: its fields have different readers, so proofdelta.ts snapshots them apart and the four rows below place each; the file's own line decides nothing
the file's prose: nothing reads it
